purpose: Auditable scope, evidence, and falsification gates for every idea raised in the August 2026 feasibility discussion.

shared_research_gates.G01_pre_registration: Freeze hypothesis, variants, metric, costs, split dates, rejection rule, and trial-family id before reading evaluation results.
shared_research_gates.G02_point_in_time_data: Every input has source, vintage, availability timestamp, market calendar, corporate-action treatment, missing-data rule, and survivorship assessment.
shared_research_gates.G03_causal_execution: Signals use only information available before the decision; returns begin after the decision and include spread, slippage, fees, borrow, and turnover where applicable.
shared_research_gates.G04_chronological_validation: Use chronological development, validation, and final out-of-sample partitions; no random train/test split for time-series claims.
shared_research_gates.G05_multiple_testing: Record every attempted variant in one family and require a familywise or false-discovery-adjusted test; failed trials cannot disappear.
shared_research_gates.G06_controls: Compare with a simple benchmark plus stale, permuted, inverted, or placebo controls appropriate to the hypothesis.
shared_research_gates.G07_robustness: Require parameter-neighborhood stability, adverse-cost stress, subperiod/regime stability, endpoint sensitivity, and serial block-bootstrap evidence.
shared_research_gates.G08_economic_value: Require positive net out-of-sample contribution and either improved portfolio risk-adjusted return or a documented independent risk/information benefit.
shared_research_gates.G09_determinism: A repeated frozen-input run must reproduce decision-bearing artifacts byte-for-byte or reproduce all declared numeric outputs within an explicitly frozen tolerance.
shared_research_gates.G10_untouched_forward: No strategy receives production approval before at least 52 weekly untouched observations under an immutable version and reconciled paper execution.
shared_research_gates.G11_risk_budget: Sizing is capped, volatility-aware, liquidity-aware, and drawdown-limited; Kelly may inform a cap but may never override portfolio constraints.
shared_research_gates.G12_no_live_side_effects: Research runners must not submit orders, scrape restricted sources, post messages, or mutate external accounts.

recursive_loop_contract.objective: Generate, backtest, diagnose, and revise candidates without allowing the loop to learn from the final out-of-sample gate.
recursive_loop_contract.primary_research_metric: ICIR where a cross-sectional prediction and enough assets exist; otherwise a predeclared strategy metric with an explicit reason ICIR is inapplicable.
recursive_loop_contract.formula: ICIR = mean chronological rank IC / standard deviation chronological rank IC; the factor direction is frozen using development data only.
recursive_loop_contract.feedback_boundary: Only development and inner-validation diagnostics may be returned to the generator. Final out-of-sample results are terminal pass/fail evidence and cannot trigger another variant in the same trial family.
stop_rules: Stop at the predeclared maximum number of variants or compute budget.
Stop when no candidate improves the inner-validation objective by the frozen minimum increment.
Stop and reject the family if the final out-of-sample gate fails; do not tune to that failure.
A passing retrospective gate starts an immutable forward shadow; it does not approve live trading.
recursive_loop_contract.result_contract: The engine writes an append-only JSONL TrialLedger to a caller-selected path; no standalone production result is implied.

items.checklist_label: Market makes the most money while closed
items.claim: Close-to-open returns may explain a material share of long-run equity returns and may contain a tradable or allocation-relevant effect.
current_evidence: No dedicated saved result before this program; existing adjusted-close backtests cannot separate overnight from intraday return.
prerequisites: Point-in-time daily open and prior close
Executable close/open cost and gap-risk assumptions
success_gates: Controlling program gate: post-2021 overnight net return is positive at 25 bps round trip and Sharpe exceeds 0.5
Research escalation additionally requires stable attribution across SPY, QQQ, and IWM plus robustness before any overlay test
Any later portfolio overlay must improve OOS Sharpe without worse maximum drawdown
rejection_gates: Effect disappears after costs or corporate-action correction
One subperiod supplies nearly all performance
Open-price timestamp or split leakage changes the sign
Overlay adds no portfolio value
block_gates: No trustworthy open-price vintage
No auditable close auction/open auction execution assumption

completion_definition.coverage_complete: Every item has a registry row, status, evidence, prerequisites, gates, and intended artifacts.
completion_definition.implementation_complete: Every non-blocked runnable item has deterministic code/tests and a saved result; external tools have an isolated evaluation result.
completion_definition.research_complete: A result may be pass, fail, or blocked. Failure is a completed falsification, not unfinished work.
completion_definition.production_complete: Not part of this run. Requires all shared gates including 52 untouched weekly observations and explicit approval; live trading remains disabled.
